page.notes: Index of "Musculi Psalter", three columns. Uncertain: the page number "4" at the top is faint. The long s is read as s throughout. The printed "pij" is read as "pii" (ij ligature). Some numbers in the middle and right columns are hard to separate from the letters around them and may be misread, notably "1304.177a", "284a", "981a" and "1000a.b". Partial letters at the line breaks in the left column (e.g. "prosperis", "sofleant") are read from context. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
